issues.title: Inconsistent spacing around function arguments
issues.description: The code contains inconsistent spacing around commas in function arguments that violates the project's rustfmt configuration. Specifically, missing space after comma and extra spaces after comma in method calls.
issues.rule_name: Rust Code Must Be Formatted According to Project rustfmt Configuration

issues.title: Cookie deletion incorrectly calls SetCookie instead of DeleteCookie
issues.description: The delete_cookie function is sending a WebviewMessage::SetCookie message instead of WebviewMessage::DeleteCookie. This causes the cookie to be set/updated instead of being deleted when the delete_cookie API is called. Any code attempting to delete cookies will fail to remove them, and may inadvertently persist or update cookies that should be removed. This breaks the entire cookie deletion functionality and creates a security concern where sensitive cookies cannot be properly removed.

issues.title: Window size applied before position in window_features causing incorrect window placement
issues.description: In the window_features method, the size configuration is now applied before the position configuration, reversing the original order. This can lead to incorrect window positioning behavior because some window managers calculate the final window position based on the current window size. When the size is set after the position, the position may be recalculated or adjusted incorrectly. This particularly affects windows opened through the on_new_window handler when both size and position are specified in NewWindowFeatures.

issues.title: Changed window naming pattern breaks window label consistency
issues.description: The window label format for dynamically created windows has been changed from "new-{number}" to "new-window-{number}". This breaks the established naming convention and will cause any code that attempts to retrieve or manipulate these windows using the expected label format to fail. For example, code trying to access "new-0" or "new-1" will not find the windows, as they are now named "new-window-0" and "new-window-1". This affects window management, event handling, and any window lookup operations that depend on the label pattern.

issues.title: Public re-export lacks rustdoc documentation
issues.description: A new public API item (`pub use tauri_runtime::Cookie;`) was added without a `///` documentation comment. Line comments (`// ...`) do not satisfy the rule requiring rustdoc comments for public APIs.
issues.problematic_code_snippet:
// Remove this re-export in v3
pub use tauri_runtime::Cookie;
issues.rule_name: Public APIs Must Include Documentation Comments

issues.title: New code uses unwrap() on fallible operations
issues.description: Added code introduces multiple `unwrap()` calls on fallible operations (`parse().unwrap()`, `set_title(...).unwrap()`, and `build().unwrap()`), which violates the rule prohibiting panics/unwraps in favor of explicit error handling via `Result`.
issues.rule_name: Functions Should Return Result Types for Fallible Operations

issues.title: User-facing API change without a .changes entry
issues.description: This PR changes a user-facing API (renaming/replacing `with_window_features` with `window_features` and updating docs/examples accordingly) but does not add any markdown change file under `.changes/` in the diff, violating the requirement to include a covector change file for releasable functionality/API changes.
issues.rule_name: Changes Requiring a Version Bump Must Include a Change File

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #14020 - fix: a few regressions from previous PRs

structured_output.summary:
This PR is meant to clean up a few regressions from #13661 and #13876. It removes a redundant `.clone()` in `WryWebviewDispatcher::delete_cookie`, brings back the `tauri::webview::Cookie` re-export (with a "remove in v3" note), renames `WebviewWindowBuilder::with_window_features` to `window_features` to match the builder's naming style, and moves the API example's `on_new_window` handler into the `#[cfg(all(desktop, not(test)))]` block.

The re-export, the rename and the example change look fine. The rename is safe because `with_window_features` hasn't shipped yet: it only appears in the pending `.changes/on_new_window.md` and not in `CHANGELOG.md`. The bad part is the "redundant clone" edit. Besides dropping `.clone()`, it changed the message from `WebviewMessage::DeleteCookie` to `WebviewMessage::SetCookie`. Now `delete_cookie()` sets the cookie it was asked to delete. The edited `window_features` body also has formatting that `cargo fmt --check` will reject.
structured_output.verdictRationale: `delete_cookie` now sends a `SetCookie` message, so deleting a cookie writes it instead. That breaks a public API and has to be fixed before merge.

architecture.overview:
In Tauri, the public `Webview::set_cookie` and `Webview::delete_cookie` methods call the runtime's `WebviewDispatch` trait. The Wry implementation (`WryWebviewDispatcher`) turns each call into a `WebviewMessage` and sends it to the event loop. There, a `match` on the message calls the matching wry `webview.set_cookie` or `webview.delete_cookie`. Which wry method runs depends only on the message variant the dispatcher picks.

This PR touches three areas. First, the dispatcher's `delete_cookie` (it drops a clone, and also changes the variant it sends). Second, the public surface of the `tauri::webview` module: the `Cookie` re-export comes back and `with_window_features` becomes `window_features`. Third, the API example now registers its `on_new_window` handler only on desktop, non-test builds.
steps: Start at the public `tauri::webview` surface in `crates/tauri/src/webview/mod.rs`: `pub use tauri_runtime::Cookie` is restored so `tauri::webview::Cookie` works again.

Follow `Webview::delete_cookie` into `WryWebviewDispatcher::delete_cookie` in `crates/tauri-runtime-wry/src/lib.rs` (around line 1710). It wraps the cookie in a `WebviewMessage` and sends it to the event loop.
The event loop's handler (around line 3730) matches on the variant: `SetCookie` calls `webview.set_cookie`, and `DeleteCookie` calls `webview.delete_cookie`.
`WebviewWindowBuilder::window_features` (renamed from `with_window_features`) in `webview_window.rs` copies size, position and platform opener config from `NewWindowFeatures` onto the builder.
In `examples/api/src-tauri/src/lib.rs`, the `on_new_window` closure, its window counter and the cloned app handle now sit inside the `#[cfg(all(desktop, not(test)))]` block.

findings.title: `delete_cookie` now sends `SetCookie`, so deleting a cookie writes it
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-runtime-wry/src/lib.rs`, `WryWebviewDispatcher::delete_cookie` (around lines 1712-1722) sends `WebviewMessage::SetCookie(cookie.into_owned())`. That makes `delete_cookie` set the cookie instead of deleting it. Change it to send `WebviewMessage::DeleteCookie(cookie.into_owned())`, keeping the removal of the redundant `.clone()`. The event-loop handler for `DeleteCookie` already exists around line 3737. If possible, add a test or check that a cookie set and then deleted is no longer returned by `cookies()`.

findings.title: Edited lines in `window_features` will fail `cargo fmt --check`
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri/src/webview/webview_window.rs`, `window_features` (lines 1315-1322) has bad spacing: `inner_size(size.width,    size.height)` and `position(position.x,position.y)`. Run `cargo fmt` on the crate, or fix both to use one space after each comma, so `cargo fmt --check` passes.

findings.title: Restoring the `Cookie` re-export keeps existing imports working
findings.body:
Bringing back `pub use tauri_runtime::Cookie` keeps `tauri::webview::Cookie` imports compiling. The type is the same `cookie::Cookie` that the `pub use cookie` crate re-export already exposes, so nothing conflicts. The private `use cookie::Cookie` was removed correctly, and the "Remove this re-export in v3" comment records why it's there.

::code{file="crates/tauri/src/webview/mod.rs" lines="21-23"}

findings.title: The `with_window_features` → `window_features` rename hasn't shipped, so nothing breaks
findings.body: `with_window_features` came in with #13876. It only appears in the pending `.changes/on_new_window.md`, not in `CHANGELOG.md`, so renaming it now breaks no released API. The new name matches the builder's other setters (`title`, `inner_size`, …). The doc examples in `mod.rs` and `webview_window.rs` and the API example were all updated, and a repo grep finds no other references to the old name.

findings.title: API example: `on_new_window` setup now only runs on desktop
findings.body:
The `on_new_window` handler, the cloned `app_` handle and the window counter now sit inside the `#[cfg(all(desktop, not(test)))]` block. `window_features` is only compiled for desktop OS targets, so this keeps mobile and test builds compiling and removes the unused top-level `AtomicUsize` import. One nit: `let mut created_window_count` doesn't need `mut`, because `fetch_add` takes `&self`.

::code{file="examples/api/src-tauri/src/lib.rs" lines="74-102"}
